z-m-23-05.prereq.0: H1 mubasa iri inongoratidza kuoma kwerudzi rwekugadzira urwu; haireve kuti kurikuramu kunopa zvirimo izvi kuGredhi 1 yechikoro chepamusoro. Kutevedzana kwokudzidza kwakafungidzirwa: vadzidzi vakatodzidza zvirevo zvequadratic, kusaenzana kwequadratic, nehukama pakati pemidzi nemakoefficient.
z-m-23-05.title: Nei x + y = 6, xy = 8 ine mapeya maviri emhinduro, nenyaya ine peya imwe
z-m-23-05.topic: Huwandu hwemhinduro dze symmetric simultaneous equations dzine sum ne product yakapiwa
z-m-23-05.goal: Nzwisisa kuti mu simultaneous equations umo x ne y dzine basa rimwe chete, mhinduro dzinouya semapeya akarongwa, nekusiyana (x = y), uye ugadzire iwe pachako muenzaniso une peya imwe chete yemhinduro.
z-m-23-05.material: Mu simultaneous equations anotevera, x ne y ndema real numbers uye mhinduro dzinoverengwa semapeya akarongwa (x, y). "(2, 4)" zvinoreva "x ndi2, y ndi4" uye ipeya yakarongwa yakasiyana ne (4, 2). Simultaneous equations: x + y = 6, xy = 8. Tinofungawo nezvehuwandu hwemhinduro dze simultaneous equations dzechimiro x + y = s, xy = p (s ne p ndema integers) zvakajairika.
z-m-23-05.prereq.1: Kudzidzira simultaneous quadratic equations dzinogona kugadziriswa nekuisa linear expression mu quadratic expression
z-m-23-05.prereq.2: Zvinoreva peya yakarongwa ((2, 4) ne (4, 2) mapeya akarongwa akasiyana)
z-m-23-05.s.s1.prompt: Mapeya mangani emapeya akarongwa e real (x, y) anogutsa zvose x + y = 6 ne xy = 8?
z-m-23-05.s.s1.hint.0: Isa 2, 4, 3 se x imwe imwe, sarudza y kuti sum ive 6, uye utarise kana equation yechipiri xy = 8 ichishanda.
z-m-23-05.s.s1.hint.1: Rongedza mutafura kana (2, 4), (4, 2), ne (2, 2) dzimwe nedzimwe dzichigutsa ma equations ose maviri.
z-m-23-05.s.s1.r.a: Kutonga uku kunoverenga mapeya maviri akarongwa ane makosha e x ne y akatsiviwa semhinduro dzakasiyana.
z-m-23-05.s.s1.r.b: (2, 4) zvinoreva "x ndi2, y ndi4" uye (4, 2) zvinoreva "x ndi4, y ndi2". Tarisa kana makosha e x ne y mu ma equations maviri akasiyana.
z-m-23-05.s.s1.o.c: Mapeya 4: isa 2 ne4 zvakasununguka mu x ne y
z-m-23-05.s.s1.r.c: Isa (2, 2) ne (4, 4) mu ma equations maviri uye utarise kana sum iri 6.
z-m-23-05.s.s1.o.d: Hazvigoni kutarwa: equation yeproduct ine mhinduro dzisingaperi
z-m-23-05.s.s1.r.d: Equation imwe neimwe oga ine mhinduro dzisingaperi, asi kuti mapeya mangani anogutsa ma equations ose maviri panguva imwe chete anofanira kushandwa zvakaparadzana.
z-m-23-05.s.s1.explain: Kana x yatarwa, y inotarwa nemamiriro e sum y = 6 − x, uye kubva pa xy = 8, x(6 − x) = 8, ndiko kuti, (x − 2)(x − 4) = 0. Kana x = 2, y = 4, uye kana x = 4, y = 2, saka mapeya akarongwa mapeya maviri (2, 4) ne (4, 2). (2, 2) ne (4, 4) hadzina sum 6, saka hadzisi mhinduro.
z-m-23-05.s.s2.prompt: Mina akafunga nezvehuwandu hwemhinduro dze simultaneous equations dzechimiro x + y = s, xy = p sezvizvi. Mutsara upi ndowekutanga wakashata?
z-m-23-05.s.s2.hint.0: Isa (3, 3) kubva mumitsara 3 ne4 mu ma equations maviri kutarisa kuti inoshanda, wozoenzanisa nechirevo chemitsara 1 ne2.
z-m-23-05.s.s2.hint.1: Tsvaga kana pane nyaya apo (a, b) ne (b, a), dzakatsiviwa kurongeka, dziri peya imwe chete yakarongwa, uye hukama hupi pakati pe a ne b hunoita izvi.
z-m-23-05.s.s2.line.0: x + y = s, xy = p hazvichinji kunyange x ne y dzikatsiviwa. Saka kana (a, b) iri mhinduro, (b, a) inewo mhinduro.
z-m-23-05.s.s2.line.1: Saka mhinduro dzinouya semapeya e (a, b) ne (b, a) chete, uye huwandu hwemhinduro hunogara huri even.
z-m-23-05.s.s2.line.2: Semuenzaniso, mu x + y = 6, xy = 9, kuisa y = 6 − x mu xy = 9 kunopa x(6 − x) = 9, ndiko kuti, (x − 3)² = 0.
z-m-23-05.s.s2.line.3: Ipapo x = 3, y = 3, saka mhinduro ndiyo peya imwe chete (3, 3).
z-m-23-05.s.s2.line.4: Yaifanira kuva even asi ndipeya imwe chete, saka kuverenga kwemutsara 3 kwakashata.
z-m-23-05.s.s2.explain: Mutsara 2 ndowekutanga wakashata. (a, b) ne (b, a) ipeya yakarongwa imwe chete kana a = b, saka hadziiti peya. Mutsara 3 wakaverengwa zvakarurama se (x − 3)² = 0, uye (3, 3) inogutsa ma equations ose maviri (3 + 3 = 6, 3 · 3 = 9). Saka mhedziso yemutsara 5 yakashatawo.
z-m-23-05.s.s3.prompt: Kune x + y = s, xy = p (s ne p ndema integers), gadzira simultaneous equations 3 dzakasiyana dzine peya imwe chete chaiyo yemhinduro dze real (x, y). Mushure mekudzigadzira, tsanangura kuti nei pane peya imwe chete.
z-m-23-05.s.s3.hint.0: Kana pane peya imwe chete, (a, b) ne (b, a), dzakatsiviwa kurongeka, dzinofanira kuva peya imwe chete. Nyora kuti hukama hupi pakati pe a ne b hunodiwa.
z-m-23-05.s.s3.hint.1: Verenga sum ne product ye x, y nehukama uhwo (semuenzaniso, x = y = 3) uye usarudze s ne p.
z-m-23-05.s.s3.fail.c1: Ndapota tora s ne p seema integers.
z-m-23-05.s.s3.fail.c2: Hapana peya imwe chete yemhinduro. Pane mapeya maviri e real (x, y) anogutsa ma equations ose maviri, kana hapana zvachose.
z-m-23-05.s.s3.explain: Kana pane peya imwe chete, x = y, saka s = 2x, p = x², uye s² = 4p. Mienzaniso: (s, p) = (2, 1) → (1, 1), (4, 4) → (2, 2), (−6, 9) → (−3, −3), (0, 0) → (0, 0). (6, 8) ine mapeya maviri, (2, 4) ne (4, 2), uye (2, 5) haina real solutions (complex solutions chete). Zvakafanana nekutaura kuti quadratic equation t² − st + p = 0 ine double root.
z-m-23-05.s.s3.because.prompt: Uchishandisa mabasa e x ne y, tsanangura kuti nei simultaneous equations dzawakangogadzira dzine peya imwe chete yemhinduro.
z-m-23-05.s.s3.because.hint.0: Nyora kuti ma equations maviri anova chii kana x ne y dzakatsiviwa.
z-m-23-05.s.s3.because.hint.1: Nyora kuti hukama hupi (a, b) ne (b, a) dzinahwo kana pane peya imwe chete yemhinduro.
z-m-23-05.s.s3.because.placeholder: Muenzaniso: Kunyange tikatsiva x ne y, ... saka ...
z-m-23-05.s.s3.because.selfAssess.0: Wakanyora mamiriro apo (a, b) ne (b, a) dzinova dzakafanana here?
z-m-23-05.s.s3.because.selfAssess.1: Wakatarisa here kuti s ne p dzawakagadzira dzinobatana sei nemamiriro iwayo?
z-m-23-05.s.s3.because.model.0: Kunyange tikatsiva x ne y, ma equations anoramba akadaro, saka kana (a,b) iri mhinduro, (b,a) inewo mhinduro. Kuti pave nepeya imwe chete, mhinduro mbiri dzinofanira kuva dzakafanana, saka nyaya yega ndi a=b, ndiko kuti x=y.
z-m-23-05.s.s3.because.model.1: Kana mhinduro iri (a, b), saka (b, a), yakatsiviwa kurongeka, inewo mhinduro, saka kazhinji dzinouya semapeya. Kuti pave nepeya imwe chete, nhamba mbiri dzinofanira kuva dzakafanana, saka nyaya yega ndi s=2x, p=x² inoshanda.
z-m-23-05.s.s3.because.modelNote.1: Yakabatanidzwa kusvika kuma equations ane s ne p.

z-m-23-01.title: x⁴ + x² − 6 = 0: kutarisa mhinduro inoti pane midzi chaiyo mina
z-m-23-01.topic: Kutonga huwandu hwemidzi chaiyo yechirevo che quartic muchimiro che quadratic mu x²
z-m-23-01.goal: Muchirevo che quartic chakagadziriswa nokuita x² tsamba itsva, tarisa muganho umo kukosha kwetsamba itsva kunogona kupa x chaiyo kuti utsvage kukanganisa mukugadzirisa, uye utsanangure mamiriro umo zviratidzo zvemakoefficient zvega zvinosarudza huwandu hwemidzi chaiyo.
z-m-23-01.material: Yeongseo akagadzirisa chirevo che quartic x⁴ + x² − 6 = 0 kuti atsvage mhinduro dzose chaiyo (midzi chaiyo). Pano, midzi chaiyo inoreva mhinduro dzinhamba chaiyo chete, uye mhinduro dzisiri chaiyo hadziverengwi. (x⁴ inoverengwa se "x to the fourth power" uye x² se "x squared".)
z-m-23-01.prereq.0: H1 mubasa iri inongoratidza kuoma kwerudzi rwekugadzira urwu; haireve kuti kurikuramu kunopa zvirimo izvi kuGredhi 1 yechikoro chepamusoro. Kutevedzana kwokudzidza kwakafungidzirwa: vadzidzi vakatodzidza zvirevo zvequadratic, kusaenzana kwequadratic, nehukama pakati pemidzi nemakoefficient.
z-m-23-01.prereq.1: Kudzidzira kugadzirisa nokugadzira zvinhu zvechirevo che quadratic mu x²
z-m-23-01.prereq.2: Kutonga zviratidzo uchishandisa huwandu nechigadzirwa chemidzi miviri yechirevo che quadratic
z-m-23-01.prereq.3: Kusiyanisa nhamba chaiyo nenhamba isiri chaiyo (hapana nhamba chaiyo inopa kukosha kusina kunaka kana yakaiswa sikweya)
z-m-23-01.s.s1.prompt: Mutsetse upi mukugadzirisa kwaYeongseo ndiwo wekutanga wakanganisa? Sarudza mutsetse mumwe. (Kukanganisa kunotevera kunotsanangurwa pamwe chete mutsananguro.)
z-m-23-01.s.s1.hint.0: Isa kukosha kubva pamutsetse mumwe nomumwe zvakananga muchirevo chepakutanga x⁴ + x² − 6 uye utarise rimwe nerimwe kana ichiva 0.
z-m-23-01.s.s1.hint.1: Funga muganho wekukosha kunogona kutorwa ne x² panzvimbo ye t kuna x chaiyo, uye uenzanise mutsetse 3 nomutsetse 4.
z-m-23-01.s.s1.line.0: Kuita x² t kunopa t² + t − 6 = 0.
z-m-23-01.s.s1.line.3: Kubva pa x² = −3, x = ±√3, uye kubva pa x² = 2, x = ±√2.
z-m-23-01.s.s1.explain: Mutsetse 4 ndiwo wekutanga wakanganisa. Nhamba chaiyo x ndi 0 kana kupfuura kana yaiswa sikweya, saka hapana x chaiyo ine x² = −3. Saka ±√3 haisi midzi chaiyo (kana ukaisa x = √3 muchirevo chepakutanga, 9 + 3 − 6 = 6 ≠ 0). "Mina" yomutsetse 5 yakanganisawo nokuda kweizvi, uye midzi chaiyo mbiri, −√2 ne √2. Mitsetse 1 kusvika 3 yakarurama.
z-m-23-01.s.s2.prompt: Kunhamba dzakazara p ne q, muna x⁴ + px² + q = 0, kana uchingoziva kuti q < 0 uye usingazivi p, pane midzi chaiyo yakasiyana mingani?
z-m-23-01.s.s2.hint.0: Verenga uye uenzanise midzi chaiyo zvakananga muzvirevo zvitatu umo q yakafanana −4 uye p i −5, 0, 3.
z-m-23-01.s.s2.hint.1: Nyora sechirevo kuti chigadzirwa chemidzi miviri yechirevo che quadratic mu t=x² chinobatana sei ne q, uye utarise chiratidzo.
z-m-23-01.s.s2.o.a: 4: kukosha kuviri kwe x² kunopa x chaiyo mbiri imwe neimwe
z-m-23-01.s.s2.r.a: Kukosha umo x² isina kunaka hakupi x chaiyo. Tanga watarisa chiratidzo chekukosha kunogona kutorwa ne x².
z-m-23-01.s.s2.o.b: 2: kukosha kumwe chete kwe x² ndiko kunopa x chaiyo
z-m-23-01.s.s2.r.b: Kutonga uku kunoverenga kuti kukosha kuviri kwe x² kune zviratidzo zvipi.
z-m-23-01.s.s2.o.c: 0: x⁴ ne x² ndi 0 kana kupfuura, saka huwandu hwazvo hahugoni kuva 0
z-m-23-01.s.s2.r.c: Kana ukaisa x = 0, kukosha kwechirevo i q, iyo isina kunaka. Tarisa shanduko yechiratidzo kuti uone kana pane pakava nokukosha kwechirevo kwe 0.
z-m-23-01.s.s2.o.d: Hazvigoni kuzikanwa: zvichienderana nekukosha kwa p, i imwe ye 0, 2, kana 4
z-m-23-01.s.s2.r.d: Kutonga uku kunofunga kuti kukosha kwa p kunodikanwa. Asi tanga watarisa kana pane chokwadi chakagadzikwa ne q < 0 chete zvisinei ne p.
z-m-23-01.s.s2.explain: Chigadzirwa chemidzi miviri ye t² + pt + q = 0 ne t = x² i q < 0, saka mumwe mudzi wakanaka uye mumwe usina kunaka (discriminant p² − 4q inogara iri yakanakawo). Chete t yakanaka inopa x chaiyo mbiri, saka p ipi zvayo, pane midzi chaiyo 2 yakasiyana.
z-m-23-01.s.s3.prompt: Tsanangura, uchishandisa chiratidzo che t (= x²), kuti sei pane midzi chaiyo 2 zvisinei ne p kana q < 0, uye upe muenzaniso mumwe wenhamba umo huwandu hwemidzi chaiyo hunoenderana ne p kana q > 0.
z-m-23-01.s.s3.hint.0: Tanga wanyora mumutsara mumwe chokwadi chokuti chigadzirwa chemidzi miviri ye t i q nechiratidzo che q.
z-m-23-01.s.s3.hint.1: Semienzaniso ye q > 0, gadzirisa p = −5, q = 4 ne p = 1, q = 1 uye uverenge midzi chaiyo, wobva wanyora imwe yazvo.
z-m-23-01.s.s3.placeholder: Muenzaniso: Kana q < 0, chigadzirwa chemidzi miviri ye t i ... saka ...
z-m-23-01.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Wakashandisa here chokwadi chokuti midzi miviri ye t ine zviratidzo zvakasiyana kana q < 0 sechikonzero?
z-m-23-01.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Wakanyora here hukama hwokuti "t yakanaka chete inopa x chaiyo"?
z-m-23-01.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Wakagadzirisa here muenzaniso we q > 0 wawakazvipa pachako uye wakatarisa huwandu hwemidzi chaiyo?
z-m-23-01.s.s3.model.0: q ichigadzirwa chemidzi miviri ye t²+pt+q=0 uye isina kunaka, saka t imwe yakanaka uye imwe isina kunaka. Kubva pa x²=yakanaka pane x chaiyo mbiri, uye kubva pa x²=isina kunaka hapana x chaiyo, saka nguva dzose pane midzi chaiyo 2. Kana q>0, x⁴−5x²+4=0 ine t=1, 4, saka midzi chaiyo 4, asi x⁴+x²+1=0 haina midzi chaiyo.
z-m-23-01.s.s3.model.1: Kana ukaita t=x², chigadzirwa chemidzi miviri chisina kunaka, saka zviratidzo zvazvo zvakasiyana. t isina kunaka haigoni kubva pasikweya, saka x mbiri chete dzinobva pa t yakanaka ndidzo midzi chaiyo. Kunyange kana q iri yakanaka, zvinoenderana ne p: ne p=−2, q=1 pane midzi chaiyo 2, uye ne p=3, q=2 pane midzi chaiyo 0.

z-m-23-02.s.s2.fail.c1: Ndapota tora m ne n sema integer.
z-m-23-02.prereq.0: H1 mubasa iri inongoratidza kuoma kwerudzi rwekugadzira urwu; haireve kuti kurikuramu kunopa zvirimo izvi kuGredhi 1 yechikoro chepamusoro. Kutevedzana kwokudzidza kwakafungidzirwa: vadzidzi vakatodzidza zvirevo zvequadratic, kusaenzana kwequadratic, nehukama pakati pemidzi nemakoefficient.
z-m-23-02.title: Kana mumwe mudzi uri 1 + i, mumwe mudzi wakagadzikwa here?
z-m-23-02.topic: Mamiriro anodikanwa kugadzika mumwe mudzi muchirevo che quadratic chine mudzi usiri chaiyo
z-m-23-02.goal: Siyanisa ruzivo rwunodikanwa nerwunoshayiwa pakugadzika mumwe mudzi kana mumwe mudzi usiri chaiyo, uye gadzira iwe pachako mienzaniso inopesana umo makoefficient angasava chaiyo.
z-m-23-02.material: Mumwe mudzi wechirevo che quadratic x² + px + q = 0 i 1 + i. (i inhamba ine sikweya −1 uye inoverengwa se "eye".) Mina akati, "Mumwe mudzi i 1 − i," uye Doyun akati, "Izvozvo oga hazvigoni kugadzika mumwe mudzi." Haisati yataurwa kuti p ne q inhamba dzerudzi rupi.
z-m-23-02.prereq.1: Kuwedzera nokuwanza kwenhamba dzakaoma, chikamu chaiyo nechikamu chisiri chaiyo
z-m-23-02.prereq.2: Hukama hwokuti huwandu hwemidzi miviri yechirevo che quadratic i −p uye chigadzirwa i q
z-m-23-02.prereq.3: Zvinoreva discriminant (marudzi emidzi kana makoefficient ari chaiyo)
z-m-23-02.s.s1.prompt: Kunze kwechokwadi chokuti mumwe mudzi wechirevo che quadratic x² + px + q = 0 i 1 + i, ruzivo rwuri rupi rwakawedzerwa rwaizogadzika mumwe mudzi kuva chimwe chete chaizvo? Sarudza zvikamu zvose zveruzivo zvinoigadzika nenzira iyoyo.
z-m-23-02.s.s1.hint.0: Pasarudzo yega yega, tarisa rimwe nerimwe nenhamba muenzaniso unogutsa mamiriro aya asi une mumwe mudzi wakasiyana.
z-m-23-02.s.s1.hint.1: Shandisa hukama hwokuti huwandu hwemidzi miviri i −p kunyora mumwe mudzi zvakananga pasarudzo yega yega.
z-m-23-02.s.s1.r.a: Chokwadi chokuti huwandu huri chaiyo choga hachigoni kuderedza mumwe mudzi kuva mumwe chete. Nyora mumwe mudzi kana huwandu hwuri 3 uye kana huwandu hwuri 2.
z-m-23-02.s.s1.o.b: p ne q zvose zviri chaiyo
z-m-23-02.s.s1.r.b: Kutonga uku kunoziva kuti mamiriro pamakoefficient anorambidza sei chimiro chemidzi.
z-m-23-02.s.s1.r.c: Kubva pa discriminant kusina kunaka oga, haugoni kuziva kana midzi ichiuya mupeya. Verenga discriminant kana midzi iri 1 + i ne 1.
z-m-23-02.s.s1.r.d: Kutonga uku kunoshandisa hukama hwokuti huwandu hwemidzi miviri i −p.
z-m-23-02.s.s1.explain: Kana p ne q zviri chaiyo, mudzi usiri chaiyo unouya nepeya ne conjugate yawo yenhamba dzakaoma, saka mumwe mudzi wakagadzikwa se 1 − i. Kunyange kuziva kukosha kwa p kunogadzika mumwe mudzi nokuti huwandu i −p (kana p = −3, ipapo 3 − (1 + i) = 2 − i). Ruzivo rwokuti huwandu huri chaiyo harwukwani, nokuti mumwe mudzi unogona kuva 1 − i kana 2 − i. Kunyange kana discriminant isina kunaka, pane mamiriro umo midzi iri 1 + i ne 1 (p = −(2 + i), q = 1 + i, p² − 4q = −1), saka hazvigadzikwi.
z-m-23-02.s.s2.prompt: Kunyora mumwe mudzi se m + ni (m ne n nhamba dzakazara), gadzira mienzaniso 3 yakasiyana umo p iri chaiyo asi q isiri chaiyo. (Huwandu hwemidzi miviri i −p uye chigadzirwa i q. i inhamba ine sikweya −1.)
z-m-23-02.s.s2.hint.0: Tanga wanyora kuti chikamu chisiri chaiyo chehuwandu hwemidzi miviri (1 + i) + (m + ni) chinofanira kuva nekukosha kupi kuti p ive chaiyo.
z-m-23-02.s.s2.hint.1: Ne n inogutsa mamiriro echikamu chisiri chaiyo, wedzera chigadzirwa (1 + i)(m + ni), tsvaga m inoita kuti chikamu chisiri chaiyo chive 0, uye udzivise m iyoyo.
z-m-23-02.s.s2.var.n: Chikamu chisiri chaiyo n chemumwe mudzi
z-m-23-02.s.s2.ok.c2: Huwandu hwemidzi miviri huri chaiyo (p iri chaiyo).
z-m-23-02.s.s2.fail.c2: Huwandu hwemidzi miviri (1 + m) + (1 + n)i hauna kuva chaiyo. p haisi chaiyowo.
z-m-23-02.s.s2.ok.c3: Chikamu chisiri chaiyo chechigadzirwa chemidzi miviri hachisi 0, saka q haisi chaiyo.
z-m-23-02.s.s2.fail.c3: Chikamu chisiri chaiyo chechigadzirwa chemidzi miviri (m − n) + (m + n)i i 0, saka q iri chaiyo.
z-m-23-02.s.s2.explain: Kuti huwandu huve chaiyo, chikamu chisiri chaiyo 1 + n chinofanira kuva 0, saka n = −1. Ipapo chigadzirwa i (m + 1) + (m − 1)i, saka kana m ≠ 1, q haisi chaiyo. Muenzaniso: kana mumwe mudzi uri 2 − i, ipapo p = −3 (chaiyo) uye q = (1 + i)(2 − i) = 3 + i (isiri chaiyo). Kana m = 1, mumwe mudzi i 1 − i uye q = 2, iri chaiyo.
z-m-23-02.s.s3.prompt: Tsanangurira shamwari. Unogona kutaura chii pamusoro pomumwe mudzi wechirevo che quadratic chine mudzi mumwe 1 + i, kana pane chirevo chokuti "makoefficient p ne q ari chaiyo" uye kana pasina?
z-m-23-02.s.s3.hint.0: Tanga wanyora mumutsara mumwe mumwe mudzi kana pane mamiriro okuti makoefficient ari chaiyo.
z-m-23-02.s.s3.hint.1: Kana pasina mamiriro, rangarira muenzaniso wawakagadzira kare (2 − i nezvimwe) uye unyore mumutsara mumwe kuti mumwe mudzi haisi mukana mumwe chete.

z-m-23-06.title: Kugadzirisa (x − 2)(x − 5) = 3(x − 2) nekuparadzanisa mativi ose maviri
z-m-23-06.topic: Nyaya apo mhinduro inosiiwa mu equation ine factor imwe chete kumativi ose maviri
z-m-23-06.goal: Nzwisisa kuti nei, mu equation umo factor imwe chete yakawedzerwa kumativi ose maviri, nyaya apo factor iyoyo iri 0 inofanira kutariswa zvakaparadzana, uye sarudza uye ugadzire ma equations umo nzira yekugadzirisa inosiya mhinduro nema equations umo isingasiyi.
z-m-23-06.material: Mudzidzi akagadzirisa equation (x − 2)(x − 5) = 3(x − 2). x ndi real number uye mhinduro dzakadzorwawo kuma real numbers. (Nzira yekuverenga: "x minus 2 times x minus 5 equals 3 times x minus 2".)
z-m-23-06.thinking.2: Kugadzira iwe pachako mienzaniso inopikisa (mienzaniso umo mhinduro inosiiwa)
z-m-23-06.prereq.2: Kutarisa mhinduro ye equation nekuiisa mu equation yekutanga
z-m-23-06.s.s1.prompt: Mudzidzi akagadzirisa equation (x − 2)(x − 5) = 3(x − 2) sezvizvi pazasi. Mutsara upi ndowekutanga une dambudziko?
z-m-23-06.s.s1.hint.0: Nyora kuti kuverenga kupi kwakagadzira mutsara wega wega wemhinduro kubva kumutsara wapfuura, uye utarise kana kuverenga uko kuchigona kushandiswa kune x yose.
z-m-23-06.s.s1.hint.1: Kana uchiparadzanisa, nyora kuti makosha api divisor isingafaniri kuva, uye utarise kana kukosha uko kuchigoneka kune x munyaya ino.
z-m-23-06.s.s1.line.0: Mativi ose maviri e (x − 2)(x − 5) = 3(x − 2) anowedzerwa ne (x − 2).
z-m-23-06.s.s1.line.1: Kuparadzanisa mativi ose maviri ne (x − 2) kunopa x − 5 = 3.
z-m-23-06.s.s1.line.3: Kuisa x = 8 mu equation yekutanga kunopa 6 · 3 = 18 ne3 · 6 = 18, saka inoshanda.
z-m-23-06.s.s1.line.4: Saka mhinduro yega ye equation iyi ndi x = 8.
z-m-23-06.s.s1.explain: Dambudziko rinotanga kuoneka mumutsara 2. Kana x = 2, saka x − 2 ndi0, saka zvinoita sekuparadzanisa ne0. Kana ukaisa x = 2 mu equation yekutanga, mativi ose maviri ndi0, saka x = 2 inewo mhinduro. Kutarisa kwemutsara 4 kunoratidza chete kuti x = 8 mhinduro uye hakureve kuti hapana dzimwe mhinduro. Saka "yega" yemutsara 5 yakashata, uye mhinduro chaidzo ndi2 ne8.
z-m-23-06.s.s2.prompt: Ma equations anotevera ose ane factor imwe chete (x − 1) yakawedzerwa kumativi ose maviri. Ndeipi isingarasi mhinduro chero imwe kana yagadziriswa nekuparadzanisa mativi ose maviri ne (x − 1)?
z-m-23-06.s.s2.hint.0: Isa x = 1 zvakananga mu equation imwe neimwe uye utarise kana mativi ose maviri akaenzana.
z-m-23-06.s.s2.hint.1: Kune equation imwe neimwe, ita kuti ma expressions maviri asara mushure mekubvisa (x − 1) aenzane uye uenzanise kana mhinduro yayo iri 1.
z-m-23-06.s.s2.r.a: Uku kutonga kwakaenzanisa kana x = 1 iri mhinduro uye kana iri pakati pemhinduro dze expression yasara mushure mekuparadzanisa.
z-m-23-06.s.s2.r.b: Isa x = 1 kuona kana mativi ose maviri ari 0, uye uenzanise kana mhinduro ye expression yasara mushure mekuparadzanisa, x + 2 = 4, iri 1.
z-m-23-06.s.s2.r.c: x = 1 mhinduro, asi mhinduro yega ye expression yasara mushure mekuparadzanisa, 3 = x + 4, ndi−1.
z-m-23-06.s.s2.r.d: x = 1 mhinduro, asi mhinduro yega ye expression yasara mushure mekuparadzanisa, x − 3 = 2, ndi5.
z-m-23-06.s.s2.explain: Mu ma equations ose mana, kuisa x = 1 kunoita kuti mativi ose maviri ave 0, saka x = 1 mhinduro. Kana mhinduro ye equation yasara mushure mekuparadzanisa iri 1, hapana mhinduro inosiiwa. a inopa 2 kubva ku x + 2 = 4, b inopa −1 kubva ku 3 = x + 4, uye c inopa 5 kubva ku x − 3 = 2, saka zvose zvinosiya x = 1. d inopa x = 1 kubva ku x + 3 = 4, saka hapana mhinduro inosiiwa, uye sezvo iri (x − 1)² = 0, mhinduro yega ndi1.
z-m-23-06.s.s3.prompt: Mu ma equations echimiro (x − a)(x − b) = c(x − a) (a, b, c ndema integers kubva ku−9 kusvika ku9), gadzira ma equations 3 akasiyana umo nzira yekugadzirisa yekuparadzanisa ne (x − a) inosiya mhinduro imwe. Equation imwe chete yakanyorwa zvakasiyana (a imwe chete ne b + c imwe chete) inoverengwa semuenzaniso mumwe chete.
z-m-23-06.s.s3.hint.0: Tanga wasarudza a uye utarise kuti x = a mhinduro ye equation yekutanga, wozosarudza b ne c kuti mhinduro ye x − b = c, inowanikwa nekuenzanisa zvinhu zvasara, ive yakasiyana ne a.
z-m-23-06.s.s3.hint.1: Kana uchigadzira (a, b, c) dzakawanda, tarisa kuti dzine a imwe chete ne b + c imwe chete equation imwe chete, uye usarudze a kana b + c yakasiyana.
z-m-23-06.s.s3.fail.c2: a, b, c dzinofanira kuva kubva ku−9 kusvika ku9.
z-m-23-06.s.s3.ok.c3: x = a mhinduro asi inosiyana nemhinduro x = b + c ye equation yasara mushure mekuparadzanisa, saka inosiiwa.
z-m-23-06.s.s3.fail.c3: x = a yakafanana nemhinduro b + c ye equation yasara mushure mekuparadzanisa, saka hapana mhinduro inosiiwa.
z-m-23-06.s.s3.explain: (x − a)(x − b) = c(x − a) i (x − a)(x − b − c) = 0, saka mhinduro ndi x = a ne x = b + c. Nzira yekugovanisa inowana x = b + c chete. Kana a ≠ b + c, mhinduro a inosiiwa. Mienzaniso: (a, b, c) = (2, 5, 3) → mhinduro 2 ne8, (1, 4, 0) → 1 ne4. Kune (2, −1, 3), b + c = 2 = a, saka mhinduro imwe chete i2 uye hapana chinosiiwa.
z-m-23-06.s.s3.because.prompt: Tsanangura kuti mhinduro yakasiiwa i kukosha kupi uye kuti nei nzira iyi yekugadzirisa isingagone kushandiswa sezvayakaita pakukosha ikoko.
z-m-23-06.s.s3.because.hint.0: Nyora kuti expression x − a i0 pakukosha kupi kwe x.
z-m-23-06.s.s3.because.hint.1: Nyora kuti divi rega rega rinova chii kana ukaisa x iyoyo mu equation yepakutanga.
z-m-23-06.s.s3.because.selfAssess.0: Wakanyora here chaizvo kuti mhinduro yakasiiwa i x = a?
z-m-23-06.s.s3.because.selfAssess.1: Wakabatanidza here chokwadi chekuti x − a i0 pakukosha ikoko ne"haugone kugovanisa ne0"?
z-m-23-06.s.s3.because.model.0: Mhinduro yakasiiwa i x=a. Kana x=a, ipapo x−a i0 uye hatigoni kugovanisa ne0, saka tinofanira kuongorora nyaya iyoyo zvakaparadzana.
z-m-23-06.s.s3.because.model.1: Mhinduro x=a, umo factor yakafanana x−a i0, imhinduro ye equation yepakutanga, asi nzira inogovanisa neexpression iri 0 ipapo, saka mhinduro iyi inonyangarika. Unofanira kuisa kukosha ikoko mu equation yepakutanga zvakaparadzana.

z-m-23-03.title: Bhora rakakandwa riri pasi riri rini, pa 6 m kana pasi?
z-m-23-03.topic: Kushandisa kusaenzana kwequadratic: kufunga muganho wechinochinja zvakare
z-m-23-03.goal: Mumamiriro akaitwa nomuenzaniso wokusaenzana kwequadratic, usatakure mhinduro yechirevo sezvayakaita semhinduro, asi uidudzire pamwe chete nomuganho umo muenzaniso unoshanda, uye ugadzire iwe pachako kukosha kunosangana nemamiriro.
z-m-23-03.material: Bhora rakakandirwa kumusoro kubva pakukwirira kwe 1 m pamusoro pepasi. Kukwirira shure kwemasekonzi t kubva pakukandwa kunopiwa ne h(t) = −5t² + 20t + 1 (chikamu: m), uye chirevo ichi chinogona kushandiswa chete bhora richiri kubhururuka (kubva panguva yokukandwa kusvika panguva yarinosvika pasi). Regerera kuramba kwemhepo.
z-m-23-03.thinking.0: Kugadzirisa zvinotarisirwa nokuenda nokudzoka pakati petafura nechirevo
z-m-23-03.prereq.1: Kugadzirisa kusaenzana kwequadratic nokuverenga zviratidzo zvokusaenzana zvemhinduro
z-m-23-03.s.s1.prompt: Unoda kuziva kuti bhora rakakandwa riri pasi rinenge riri rini, pa 6 m kana pasi. Tarisa kuti kutonga kwako kunochinja sei nguva imwe neimwe chikamu cheruzivo chichiratidzwa.
z-m-23-03.s.s1.hint.0: Enzanisa kukwirira panguva imwe neimwe patafura ne 6 m uye uise mamaki pamitsetse iri pa 6 m kana pasi.
z-m-23-03.s.s1.hint.1: Isa nguva dzisiri patafura (0.5 s, 3.5 s) muchirevo uye utarise kana kukwirira kuri pa 6 m kana pasi.
z-m-23-03.s.s1.st.0.info:
Bhora rakakandirwa kumusoro kubva pakukwirira kwe 1 m pamusoro pepasi. Kukwirira shure kwemasekonzi t kubva pakukandwa i h(t) = −5t² + 20t + 1 (chikamu m), uye chirevo ichi chinogona kushandiswa chete bhora richiri kubhururuka (kubva panguva yokukandwa kusvika panguva yarinosvika pasi). Kukwirira panguva dzimwe chete ndeuku.
t (s): 0, 1, 2, 3, 4
h (m): 1, 16, 21, 16, 1
z-m-23-03.s.s1.st.0.ask: Shure kwokukandwa kukwirira kuri pa 6 m kana pasi rinhi? Tarisa tafura uye utanga wafungidzira.
z-m-23-03.s.s1.st.0.after: Kutarisa tafura, kukwirira kuri pasi pa 1 m pa 0 s ne 4 s, uye 16 m kana kupfuura kubva pa 1 kusvika pa 3 s. Saka zvinoratidzika kuti nguva dzakadzika ndedzaviri, padyo nokutanga nepadyo nokupera. Asi tafura inoratidza masekonzi akazara chete, saka unoda chirevo kuti uzive chaizvo kuti miganho iri papi.
z-m-23-03.s.s1.st.0.o.a: Zvinoratidzika kuti ndenguva mbiri, pakarepo mushure mokukandwa napakarepo bhora risati rwawira
z-m-23-03.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Kutonga uku kunoona kuti kukwirira kuri pasi pakutanga (0 s) napadyo nokupera (4 s) patafura.
z-m-23-03.s.s1.st.0.o.b: Zvinoratidzika kuti ndekamwe chete, pakarepo mushure mokukandwa (nokuti rinokurumidza kukwira)
z-m-23-03.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Wakakanganwa mutsetse une kukwirira kwe 1 m pa 4 s. Enzanisa mutsetse wokupedzisira wetafura ne 6 m.
z-m-23-03.s.s1.st.0.o.c: Zvinoratidzika kuti padyo ne 2 s, bhora riri pakukwirira zvikuru
z-m-23-03.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Pa 2 s kukwirira i 21 m, kukwirira zvikuru. Verenga zvakare kuti mubvunzo unobvunza kuti kukwirira kuri pasi rinhi.
z-m-23-03.s.s1.st.0.o.d: Hatigoni kuziva kubva pamasekonzi akazara chete, saka tinoda kugadzirisa chirevo
z-m-23-03.s.s1.st.0.r.d: Kutonga uku kunoziva muganho wokuti tafura inoratidza masekonzi akazara chete.
z-m-23-03.s.s1.st.1.info: Kurongedza zvakare −5t² + 20t + 1 ≤ 6 kunopa t² − 4t + 1 ≥ 0. Kukosha kwa t kunoita kuti chirevo ichi che quadratic chive 0 ndi 2 − √3 ≈ 0.27 ne 2 + √3 ≈ 3.73. Kutarisa chirevo choga, unowana t ≤ 0.27 kana t ≥ 3.73.
z-m-23-03.s.s1.st.1.ask: Unogona kunyora mhedzisiro iyi semhinduro ye "nguva dzakadzika" sezvayakaita here?
z-m-23-03.s.s1.st.1.after: Pa t = 0.2 ne 3.8, kukwirira i 4.8 m kuzvose zviviri, saka kuva pa 6 m kana pasi kwakarurama. Asi t ≥ 3.73 haina mugumo, saka inosanganisira nguva shure kwokunge bhora rasvika pasi. Chirevo ichi chinogona kushandiswa chete bhora richiri kubhururuka, saka unofanira kufunga muganho we t.
z-m-23-03.s.s1.st.1.o.a: Hongu. Mhinduro yokusaenzana yabuda, saka ndiyo mhinduro sezvayakaita
z-m-23-03.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Kutonga uku kwakangotakura mhinduro yechirevo. Verenga zvakare mutsara wokutanga weruzivo kuti uone kuti chirevo ichi chinogona kushandiswa panguva dzipi.
z-m-23-03.s.s1.st.1.o.b: Tinofanira kutarisa kana muganho we t uri nenguva iri bhora richibhururuka chete
z-m-23-03.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Kutonga uku kunoziva muganho umo chirevo chinogona kushandiswa.
z-m-23-03.s.s1.st.1.o.c: Mhinduro inogona kunge yakanganisa. Tafura nenguva mbiri hazvienderani
z-m-23-03.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Tafura (0 s ne 4 s dzakadzika) nemhedzisiro (padyo nokutanga, padyo nokupera) chaizvo zvinoenderana zvakanaka. Fungidzira kukosha kwemidzi uye uienzanise netafura.
z-m-23-03.s.s1.st.1.o.d: Tanga waenzanisa zvakadzama nokuisa t = 0.2 ne 3.8 muchirevo kuti uone kana kukwirira kuri pa 6 m kana pasi
z-m-23-03.s.s1.st.1.r.d: Kutonga uku kunotarisa mhedzisiro netafura nokufungidzira.
z-m-23-03.s.s1.st.2.info: Nguva yokusvika kwebhora pasi ndiyo kana h(t) = 0. Kubva pa −5t² + 20t + 1 = 0, t = 2 + √4.2 ≈ 4.05 (s). Saka nguva dzinoenda bhora richibhururuka ndi 0 ≤ t ≤ 4.05.
z-m-23-03.s.s1.st.2.ask: Zvakakodzera sei kunyora nguva dzokuti "kukwirira kuri pa 6 m kana pasi"?
z-m-23-03.s.s1.st.2.after: Nguva dzakadzika ndi 0 ≤ t ≤ 0.27 (inenge 0.27 s) ne 3.73 ≤ t ≤ 4.05 (inenge 0.32 s). Pamwe chete inenge 0.59 s, iyo pfupi.
z-m-23-03.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Renji renguva haina kunyorwa. Inogona kuverengwa sekuti bhora richiriko mushure me4.05 s.
z-m-23-03.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Wakaverenga mhinduro ye quadratic inequality t² − 4t + 1 ≥ 0 sepakati pe roots mbiri. Tarisa nechokwadi chekuti kukwirira pa2 s ndi21 m.
z-m-23-03.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Kutonga uku kwakanyora mhinduro ye expression pamwe chete nerenji umo bhora riri kubhururuka.
z-m-23-03.s.s1.st.2.r.d: Wakafungidzira 4 s senguva yekubata pasi. Pa4 s kukwirira ndi1 m, saka bhora richiri kubhururuka.
z-m-23-03.s.s1.reflect: Kufanofungidzira kwako kwekutanga kwe "nguva mbiri, padhuze nekutanga nepadhuze nekupedzisira" kwakaramba kwakadaro kusvika kumagumo. Zvakachinja ndiyo makosha chaiwo emiganhu nepoinzi yekuti unofanira kutarisa renji rinogona kutorwa nechinoshanduka usati wapfuvura mhinduro ye expression sezvayakaita. Tarisa shure kana wakatarisa renji umo expression inoshandiswa usati wanyora mhinduro ye expression.
z-m-23-03.s.s2.prompt: Nyora nguva t (s) 3 dzakasiyana apo kukwirira ndi6 m kana pasi uye bhora richiri kubhururuka. (Unogona kuidzinyora semadecimals.)
z-m-23-03.s.s2.hint.0: Isa nguva imwe pakarepo mushure mekukanda nenguva imwe pamberi pekudonha mu expression uye uverenge kukwirira.
z-m-23-03.s.s2.hint.1: Kana kukwirira kwawakaverenga kuri kukuru kupfuura 6, famisa nguva kuenda ku0 kana ku4 uye uverenge zvakare.
z-m-23-03.s.s2.fail.c1: t inofanira kuva mushure menguva yekukanda (0 s).
z-m-23-03.s.s2.fail.c2: Kukwirira kuri pasi pe0. Inguva mushure mekuti bhora ratobata pasi.
z-m-23-03.s.s2.fail.c3: Kukwirira kuri pamusoro pe6 m. Isa mu expression uye uverenge.
z-m-23-03.s.s2.explain: Nguva dzakaderera ndi0 ≤ t ≤ 0.27 kana 3.73 ≤ t ≤ 4.05. Semuenzaniso, t = 0 (1 m), 0.2 (4.8 m), 3.8 (4.8 m), 4 (1 m) dzinokodzera mamiriro. t = 0.3 kana 3.7 inopa 6.55 m, iri pamusoro pe6 m, uye t = 5 inopa kukwirira kwe−24, pazasi pepasi, saka bhora ratobata pasi.

z-m-23-04.prereq.0: H1 mubasa iri inongoratidza kuoma kwerudzi rwekugadzira urwu; haireve kuti kurikuramu kunopa zvirimo izvi kuGredhi 1 yechikoro chepamusoro. Kutevedzana kwokudzidza kwakafungidzirwa: vadzidzi vakatodzidza zvirevo zvequadratic, kusaenzana kwequadratic, nehukama pakati pemidzi nemakoefficient.
z-m-23-04.title: Tafura yemakosha inogona kutara mhinduro dze integer dze f(x) < 0 here?
z-m-23-04.topic: Kutonga mhinduro dze integer dze quadratic inequality uchishandisa tafura yemakosha nechiratidzo che quadratic function
z-m-23-04.goal: Tonga mhinduro ye quadratic inequality kubva pashanduko dzechiratidzo mutafura yemakosha e function, rongedza zvirevo zvisingagoni kuitwa netafura oga, uye utsanangure kuti mamiriro api anotara mhedziso.
z-m-23-04.material:
Function f(x) = ax² + bx + c ndi quadratic function ine coefficient ye x² a iri positive, asi hatizivi makosha e a, b, c. Chatinoziva ndetafura yemakosha iri pazasi chete, uye ma x ose mutafura ndema integers.
x: −1, 0, 1, 2, 3, 4
f(x): 3, −1, −3, −3, −1, 3
Mubvunzo: Ma integers x api anogutsa f(x) < 0? (Mutafura, mutsara wepamusoro ndi x uye mutsara wepazasi ndiko kukosha kwe f(x), uye nhamba dziri panzvimbo imwe chete dzakaitwa mapeya.)
z-m-23-04.thinking.1: Kurongedza zvirevo zvisingagoni kuitwa kubva patafura
z-m-23-04.prereq.1: Chimiro che graph ye quadratic function (chiratidzo che a nenzira yainovhurika)
z-m-23-04.prereq.2: Kusangana kwe quadratic function ne x-axis, ne axis of symmetry
z-m-23-04.prereq.3: Kuverenga mhinduro ye quadratic inequality kubva pa graph
z-m-23-04.s.s1.prompt: Kana uchishandisa tafura chete uye usingawani expression, chirevo chipi chinogona kutarwa nezve ma integers x anogutsa f(x) < 0?
z-m-23-04.s.s1.hint.0: Mutafura, ratidza pakati pema x api f inochinja kubva ku positive kuenda ku negative uye kubva ku negative kuenda ku positive.
z-m-23-04.s.s1.hint.1: Fungidzira chimiro che quadratic function ine a > 0, funga kuti ma intervals mangani anoumbwa nema x ane makosha ari pasi pe0, uye uenzanise nema integers ari kunze kwetafura.
z-m-23-04.s.s1.o.a: 1 ne2 chete. Ndipo pane kukosha kudiki zvikuru mutafura
z-m-23-04.s.s1.r.a: Kutonga uku kunotarisa kwakadzika kukosha chete. f(x) < 0 zvinoreva ma x ose ane makosha ari pasi pe0.
z-m-23-04.s.s1.o.b: Ma integers ose matanhatu mutafura, kubva ku−1 kusvika ku4
z-m-23-04.s.s1.r.b: Kutonga uku kunoona ma x ose mutafura semhinduro. Tarisazve kana koramu ine kukosha 3 ichigutsa f(x) < 0.
z-m-23-04.s.s1.o.c: 0, 1, 2, 3, uye ma integers ari kunze kwetafura haasi mhinduro
z-m-23-04.s.s1.r.c: Kutonga uku kunoshandisa zvose shanduko dzechiratidzo mutafura nechimiro che quadratic function.
z-m-23-04.s.s1.o.d: Makosha anogona kuva negative pama integers ari kunze kwetafura, saka hazvigoni kutarwa
z-m-23-04.s.s1.r.d: Kutonga uku kunoti makosha asiri mutafura haazikanwi. Funga kuti mamiriro ekuti i quadratic function uye a > 0 anokuudza chii nezve kunze kwetafura.
z-m-23-04.s.s1.explain: f(−1) = 3 > 0 uye f(0) = −1 < 0, saka chiratidzo chinochinja pakati pe−1 ne0, uye f(3) = −1 < 0 uye f(4) = 3 > 0, saka chinochinja pakati pe3 ne4. Kune quadratic function ine a > 0, ma x ane f(x) < 0 anoumba interval imwe chete, saka mhinduro ndiyo mukati mepakati pemapoinzi maviri iwayo, uye ma integers ndi0, 1, 2, 3. (Kana ukawana expression f(x) = x² − 3x − 1 ukatarisa, unowana mhedziso imwe chete.)
z-m-23-04.s.s2.prompt: Mudzidzi akafunga sezvizvi pazasi kubva patafura iri pamusoro. Sarudza mutsara wakashata, chirevo chisingagoni kuitwa netafura oga.
z-m-23-04.s.s2.hint.0: Siyanisa kana mutsara mumwe nemumwe uchitaura chinhu kubva pamakosha akanyorwa mutafura chete kana kuti uchitaura nezve makosha pa x isiri mutafura.
z-m-23-04.s.s2.hint.1: Kubva pa f(1) = f(2), nyora kuti graph yakaenzana pamusoro pe x ipi, uye uenzanise kukosha pa x iyoyo nemamwe makosha ari mutafura.
z-m-23-04.s.s2.line.0: f(−1) = 3 > 0 uye f(0) = −1 < 0, saka chiratidzo chekukosha kwe f chinochinja pakati pe−1 ne0.
z-m-23-04.s.s2.line.1: f(3) = −1 < 0 uye f(4) = 3 > 0, saka chiratidzo chinochinjawo pakati pe3 ne4.
z-m-23-04.s.s2.line.2: Kune quadratic function ine a > 0, ma x ane makosha ari pasi pe0 anoumba interval imwe chete, saka interval iyoyo iri pakati pemapoinzi maviri ari pamusoro.
z-m-23-04.s.s2.line.3: Saka ma integers x ane f(x) < 0 ndi0, 1, 2, 3.
z-m-23-04.s.s2.line.4: Zvakare, f(1) = f(2) = −3, saka kukosha kudiki kwe f ndi−3.
z-m-23-04.s.s2.explain: Mutsara 5 wakashata. Haugoni kutaura kukosha kudiki nekutarisa makosha pama integers x chete. Kana f(1) = f(2), axis of symmetry ndi x = 1.5 uye kukosha kudiki kunoitika ipapo. Mutafura iyi, f(x) = x² − 3x − 1, saka f(1.5) = −3.25, iri pasi pe−3. Mitsara 1 kusvika ku4 inogona kutaurwa zvakarurama uchishandisa tafura nemamiriro a > 0 chete.
z-m-23-04.s.s3.prompt: Kana tafura iri pamusoro chete yaipiwa, pasina mamiriro e "quadratic function ine a > 0", waigona kutara here kuti 0, 1, 2, 3 ndiwo ma integers chete ane f(x) < 0? Nyora chikonzero uye ruzivo rupi rwaizodiwa kuritara.
z-m-23-04.s.s3.hint.0: Fungidzira kuti makosha anogona kuva chero ari pakati pema integers x etafura (pakati pe1 ne2) nekunze kwetafura (5 kana kupfuura), uye ufungidzire nyaya apo ma integers ane f(x) < 0 anowedzera.
z-m-23-04.s.s3.hint.1: Tarisa shure kuti kutonga kupi kwakashandisa mamiriro e "quadratic function ine a > 0" mumadanho apfuura.
